title: Conservative structural performance advice
why: New native warnings report specific structural traversal, serial await, item-dependent declared GET and proven DOM layout patterns. Guidance is conditional and makes no purity, exact query-count, timing or safe-rewrite claim.
changelog: Conservative performance warnings expose structural review opportunities
steps: Review each native diagnostic in its exact source context.
Measure and preserve dependency, ordering, ownership and policy before changing work; no automatic edits are offered.
